overview: In the Signature teaching of power electronics, What Power Electronics Studies is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. Switching means turning transistors fully on or off thousands of times per second to control power with little loss. Rectifiers means converting AC to DC, from simple diode bridges to power-factor-corrected active front ends. Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. Rectifiers: converting AC to DC, from simple diode bridges to power-factor-corrected active front ends.

overview: In the Signature teaching of power electronics, Rectifiers is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place.
